hidden animals.flag: the note's example pOWLer hides an owl, which belongs to the sub-theme hidden birds

sounds like a letter.flag: a small closed set: only 26 members, several rare (ell, wye, cay)

sounds like a number.flag: only 10 members exist; tutu (two-two) and ait (eight) are weak

no vowels.flag: y-words plus interjections (hmm, shh, brr, psst, tsk) and Welsh borrowings (cwm, crwth)

words made of roman numerals.flag: a small set: about 20 real words use only I V X L C D M
